summary: The three most important visible problems are the skirt/petticoat intersecting the crossed thighs and shoes in cross_legged, the raised leg and shoe breaking through the skirt front in high_kick, and the skirt intersecting the upper thighs in lie_back_elbows. These are garment clearance problems; the sheets do not show comparably clear limb stretching, joint collapse, or destructive skin deformation. Several other bent-leg poses have smaller skirt intersections or rigid hems, partly expected with cloth physics disabled. Clip ratings cover the supplied samples only; continuous playback would be needed to confirm temporal popping.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Skirt front over the upper thighs and around the knees
items.issue: The skirt retains a flared shell around the seated thighs with small intersections at the leg openings, partly expected without cloth simulation.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Front hem around the folded legs
items.issue: The folded legs emerge through a stiff, open skirt front instead of the fabric settling around them, with small cloth-to-leg intersections visible in the three-quarter view.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh at the skirt front
items.issue: The raised thigh cuts into the skirt front while the surrounding hem remains broadly flared, a localized clearance problem with cloth physics disabled.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Lap, crossed upper thighs, and shoes against the skirt front
items.issue: The crossed thighs and shoes visibly pass through the skirt surface while substantial fabric remains hanging beneath them, producing an obvious garment-body intersection in both views.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Forward upper thigh and rear thigh beneath the skirt
items.issue: The forward thigh emerges through the skirt front and the rear leg meets a rigid hem, leaving localized intersections rather than fabric following the lunge.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Raised thigh beneath the front hem
items.issue: The lifted thigh meets and slightly intersects the flared skirt underside, although the exposed knee and ankle retain a plausible shape.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Raised thigh beneath the front hem
items.issue: The raised leg intersects the skirt underside locally while the hem holds a stiff flared shape, partly expected without cloth simulation.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Tucked thighs against the skirt and petticoat
items.issue: The tucked thighs meet the skirt underside with small intersections as the skirt spreads into a rigid disk, an exaggerated but understandable result of the disabled cloth physics.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Skirt front at the raised thigh and shoe
items.issue: The kicking leg visibly passes through the skirt, with the shoe protruding through the front panel in the front view and the thigh cutting across the garment in the three-quarter view.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.issue: The bulky sleeves merge into a continuous chest-level mass with little separation at their crossing, suggesting localized cloth interpenetration.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Crossed sleeves in front of the chest
items.issue: The sleeves overlap into a broad, pinched central shape that obscures their individual volumes and suggests small cloth-to-cloth intersections.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Lap and upper thighs where the legs extend through the skirt
items.issue: The upper thighs visibly emerge through the skirt surface while its front panel remains suspended between and below the legs, creating an obvious intersection rather than a draped reclining silhouette.

items.name: dance_clap
items.location: Sleeves meeting below the hands at the upper chest
items.issue: The sleeve volumes press into one another below the hands with a small central pinch, though no clear skin or joint collapse is visible.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Raised thigh beneath the skirt and sleeves meeting at the chest
items.issue: The sleeves crowd together during the chest-level gestures and the lifted thigh slightly intersects the stiff skirt underside at frames 72–74, with no definite pop established by the supplied samples.

items.name: run
items.location: Upper thighs against the skirt underside
items.issue: The alternating bent thighs meet or slightly penetrate the rigid skirt underside, while the sampled knees and ankles show no clear volume collapse or confirmed discontinuity.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Skirt front over the seated thighs and knees
items.issue: The skirt remains a stiff flared shell as the thighs fold and extend, producing localized leg intersections and an uneven lifted front hem, partly expected without cloth physics.

items.name: spin
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat expand into a nearly rigid disk with little visible folding or lag, a mild cloth realism limitation consistent with the disabled simulation.
